name: Steam Presser
notes: Steam multiblock: runs on steam from steam input hatches, no energy or maintenance hatch. Every tiered part (machine casing, gear box, pipe casing, firebox, frame) must be the same tier: bronze (shown) or steel (Solid Steel Machine Casing and steel parts; high-pressure steam, faster). Buses are steam input/output buses. Steam forge hammer (Steam Presser), 5x7x5, at least 35 machine casings; the hammer is two Blocks of Iron (bronze tier) or Blocks of Steel (steel tier) under a pipe casing. The controller sits one block back from the front edge of the base. Sharing: every hatch found during the structure check is added to each controller whose structure contains it, so steam hatches and buses in a shared wall serve both machines.
